source.paper: Cancado, Jorio, Martins Ferreira, Stavale, Achete, Capaz, Moutinho, Lombardo, Kulmala, Ferrari 2011, Nano Lett. 11, 3190, doi:10.1021/nl201432g, arXiv:1105.0175; Eckmann, Felten, Mishchenko, Britnell, Krupke, Novoselov, Casiraghi 2012, Nano Lett. 12, 3925, doi:10.1021/nl300901a, arXiv:1207.2058
source.figure: Eckmann p. 6 and abstract (I(D)/I(D') per defect type, 514.5 nm, stage 1); Cancado Eq. 4 for the defect level

notes: Synthetic from published relation; flatters the tools arm (the tools encode the same relation). Heights (peak maxima, as the papers use): I_D/I_G = 0.6000, I_D/I_D' = 7.0, I_2D/I_G = 3.0 (approximate reading of Cancado Fig. 1). Widths (FWHM, cm-1): D 15.0, G 14.0, D' 14.0 (curator choice, not in the papers), 2D 32.0. D position = 1350 + 52 (E_L - 2.41 eV) cm-1 (Cancado p. 2 and p. 5), 2D = 2 x D. Defect level rule (curator, not the paper's): L_D >= 25 nm low, 10-25 nm medium, < 10 nm high; Cancado calls L_D >= 10 nm the low-density regime. Noise: G height / sigma = 150. Defect type: vacancy-like (Eckmann 2012, I(D)/I(D') ~ 7; sp3 ~ 13, boundaries ~ 3.5). defect_type is not scored by eval/score.py. Implied L_D = 14.5 nm (Cancado Eq. 4).
